propositions: Hoisting the query ticket digest from per-call instructions into the system prompt places shared bytes into the cacheable prefix block, reducing token cost when the prefix exceeds the model's minimum cacheable threshold

The measured cache floor for claude-sonnet-4-6 is 1024 tokens, not the 4096 documented for Opus, and the hoisted prefix reaches only 846 tokens, resulting in zero cache hits and a +936 token (+5.8%) regression on the measured corpus

Judgment precision is preserved identically across all 12 ordered pairs when the digest is hoisted and relocated to the system prompt, confirmed by comparing relation, shared_artifact, and confidence between baseline and hoisted implementations
The design requires sequential execution to warm the cache on the first call before any parallel fan-out, to avoid turning one cache write into N premium writes and making parallelism a regression
